overviewParagraphs: Montgomerie Links Vietnam carries the unmistakable DNA of Colin Montgomerie's European tour sensibility, transplanted into the warm coastal climate of Da Nang. Opened in 2009, it was among the first world-class layouts to put Vietnam firmly on the international golf map.

The classic links design makes strategic use of natural rolling terrain, firm fairways, and deep pot bunkers inspired by the finest Scottish and Irish links. The layout demands a thoughtful, measured game — raw power is secondary to course management.

Part of the prestigious Montgomery Links development, the club offers an immaculate clubhouse experience with a welcoming, home-away-from-home atmosphere. Consistently rated among Vietnam's top five courses, it remains an essential fixture on any serious golf tour itinerary.

curatorBriefHtml: Montgomerie Links Vietnam (opened 2010 by Colin Montgomerie) is the quintessential approachable championship resort course on Vietnam’s Central Coast — sitting right between Da Nang and Hoi An, just 5 minutes from BRG Da Nang. Measuring 7,091 yards (Par 72), the layout weaves through windswept sand-dune corridors, casuarina pines, and dramatic water-framed par 5s — highlighted by the signature par-5 12th hole rising toward the iconic clubhouse.

Having played Montgomerie Links personally, its enduring appeal is balance and convenience. Greenside mounding and deep pot bunkers nod to Colin Montgomerie’s Scottish roots without beating up mid-handicap holiday groups, and its floodlit night golf plus top-tier driving range make it an ultra-versatile slot on any 4- to 6-round itinerary. Compare it directly in BRG Da Nang vs. Montgomerie Links.
Just 15 minutes from Hoi An / An Bang Beach villas and 20 minutes from Da Nang Airport, Montgomerie Links features on our Hoi An Beachfront Bliss and An Bang Invitational tours.

scorecard.verdict: A refined boutique experience that balances generous fairways with formidable greenside collection areas. Colin Montgomerie's strategic touches create a pleasant yet competitive challenge.

faqs.q: How does Montgomerie Links compare to BRG Da Nang Norman and Hoiana Shores?
faqs.a: Montgomerie Links is slightly softer, lusher, and more parkland-resort friendly than windswept Hoiana Shores or raw sandy BRG Norman — making it an ideal confidence-building round for mixed-handicap groups.

faqs.q: Does Montgomerie Links Vietnam offer night golf?
faqs.a: Yes — Montgomerie Links offers floodlit twilight and night-golf options, giving Da Nang visitors a second illuminated venue alongside Ba Na Hills and BRG Nicklaus.

faqs.q: How close is Montgomerie Links to Hoi An and Da Nang?
faqs.a: It sits just 15 minutes north of Hoi An / An Bang Beach and 20 minutes south of central Da Nang and Da Nang International Airport (DAD).

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Montgomerie Links?
faqs.a: February through September brings sunny coastal weather and smooth TifEagle/Paspalum greens. Morning starts (07:30–09:00 AM) beat afternoon coastal breezes.
